title: Bashar :: Signs of The Times - Highlights
author: Bashar Channeled by Darryl Anka
opening_summary: Bashar introduces the transmission on synchronicity, explaining it as physical reality demonstrating that all things are connected with no accidents or coincidences. He frames synchronicity as evidence of orchestration and interconnection throughout existence. The session sets the foundation for understanding how recognizing synchronicity can deepen one's sense of connection to all things and facilitate alignment with one's true path and passion.

qa_topics.question: How can someone who feels persistently low-energy and burnt out find inspiration to act on their passion?
qa_topics.answer_gist: True passion naturally generates energy when you act on it. Burnout signals you haven't found your unique path of least resistance; you must creatively discover your personal way rather than following inherited templates from society, family, or education.

quotes.quote: synchronicity, that experience is physical reality's way of demonstrating that all things are connected
when you actually are acting on something representative of your passion, the energy usually comes automatically
burnout and overwhelm usually is your first clue that you're not going about acting on your passion in the way that works for you
you have to find your unique way of allowing all of that to happen more effortlessly so you don't feel the burnout
